::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
health_spending %>% 
  filter(indicator_code == 'che_usd2023') %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  mutate(rank = rank(-value)) %>% 
  arrange(year, rank) %>% 
  filter(rank <= 9) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = year, y = value, group = country_name, color = iso3_code)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_y_log10() +
  geom_line()
```
